title: Experiences are self-excitations of cosmic consciousness

statements.text: Particular experiences are patterns of self-excitation of cosmic consciousness, which has an inherent disposition to self-excite, as a dance is the dancer in motion and not something distinct from the dancer.

sources.quote: I submit that (a) experiences are patterns of self-excitation of cosmic consciousness and that (b) cosmic consciousness has the inherent disposition to self-excitation.
